us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump administration prepares mass visa revocation for asylum seekers
bullets: The administration is preparing to revoke B1 and B2 visas for up to 200,000 foreign nationals.
The affected group includes people who have applied for or are currently seeking asylum in the U.S.
AP reported the move would be the largest single mass visa revocation in U.S. history if implemented.

articles.title: Supreme Court opens path for Trump mail-voting restrictions
bullets: The Supreme Court lifted a lower-court hurdle blocking parts of Trump’s mail-voting executive order.
The ruling is preliminary and does not finally decide the legality of the order.
Additional litigation could still limit what changes take effect before the November midterms.

articles.title: U.S.-Canada trade fight escalates after 50% tariffs take effect
bullets: Canada was expected to announce retaliatory tariffs against the U.S. on Tuesday.
Trump threatened new 50% tariffs on Canadian vehicles, auto parts and steel.
The dispute followed the breakdown of trade talks between Washington and Ottawa.

articles.title: Nevada crews gain ground against Hawk Fire near Reno
bullets: Firefighters reported 27% containment of the Hawk Fire near Reno on Monday.
Officials said the blaze had destroyed more than 30 homes.
Evacuation orders and warnings were reduced from more than 90,000 residents to about 63,000.

articles.title: Pan Am Flight 103 trial delayed after new evidence emerges
bullets: A federal judge postponed the U.S. trial of a Libyan man charged in the 1988 Pan Am Flight 103 bombing.
The delay was ordered after new evidence was discovered for defense attorneys to review.
The Lockerbie bombing killed 270 people and remains one of the deadliest terrorism cases tied to U.S. victims.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide stories and geopolitical developments

articles.title: U.S. widens Iran sanctions but stops short of maximum penalties
bullets: The Treasury Department sanctioned nearly 60 Iran-linked entities on Monday.
The Trump administration warned countries to sever financial ties with Iran or risk penalties.
China, Turkey and the UAE are among Iran’s largest trade partners.

articles.title: European leaders pledge more support as Ukraine marks Independence Day
bullets: Ukraine marked the 35th anniversary of its independence on Monday.
European leaders gathered in Kyiv and pledged stronger military support.
Zelenskiy said Ukraine wants peace but would not surrender to Russia at any price.

articles.title: Video appears to show hundreds abducted after Nigeria mosque attack
bullets: Reuters reported that residents identified about 600 people shown in a captivity video.
The alleged victims included women, children and older people abducted in Niger State.
The attack occurred at a mosque in north-central Nigeria last week.

articles.title: Ceasefire monitors deploy in eastern Congo under Qatar-mediated deal
bullets: A monitoring mission began observing a ceasefire in eastern Congo on Monday.
The mechanism is tied to a Qatar-mediated peace process signed last year.
The deployment covers conflict between Congolese forces and Rwandan-backed rebels.

articles.title: France and Saudi Arabia announce $7 billion theme-park project near Paris
bullets: France and Saudi Arabia agreed on a €6 billion amusement-park investment near Paris.
One park is expected to be manga-themed, with Dragon Ball Z highlighted by officials.
The project was announced during Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman’s visit to Paris.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India headlines from national outlets

articles.title: NIA searches five states in Operation Sindoor-linked cyber-terror case
bullets: The NIA conducted searches at five locations across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Telangana, Bihar and Delhi.
The case involves alleged DDoS attacks on 54 Government of India websites.
Investigators said the attacks occurred during Operation Sindoor.

articles.title: Jaishankar meets Putin as India and Russia focus on trade and energy
bullets: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow.
Putin identified energy, fertilisers, nuclear energy and high technology as priority areas.
The talks came amid continued emphasis on India-Russia economic cooperation.

articles.title: CRPF sub-inspector shot during Naga-Kuki crossfire in Manipur
bullets: A CRPF sub-inspector was shot in Manipur amid firing between armed groups.
The incident occurred between Konsakhul and Leilon Munlui villages on Monday.
Police linked the shooting to tensions involving Naga and Kuki-Zo groups.

articles.title: Amit Shah opens National Security Strategies Conference in New Delhi
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the two-day National Security Strategies Conference-2026.
The agenda included illegal migration, cybercrime policy and proxy warfare by Pakistan.
The meeting brought together officials to discuss key national security issues.

articles.title: Goa digital-arrest case leads ED to pan-India cyber-fraud network
bullets: The ED probe stems from a Goa digital-arrest fraud case.
Investigators linked the case to 330 victims and about Rs 400 crore.
Two accused were produced before a Goa court after arrest under the PMLA.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Key U.S. market movers and stock-specific headlines

articles.title: RUM Group jumps after $13.7 billion AI-chip services deal
bullets: RUM Group shares rose after announcing a six-year GPU services agreement.
The contract is worth about $13.7 billion with an unnamed U.S.-based cloud customer.
The deal involves GPU services from RUM’s Maysville, Georgia facility.

articles.title: Visa and Mastercard hit record highs on resilient consumer spending
bullets: Visa shares rose 3.1% Monday to close at $382.41.
Mastercard also closed at a record high on the same day.
The moves were reported as a sign of continued strength in U.S. consumer spending.

articles.title: Nvidia slips as chip stocks drag Nasdaq lower
bullets: Nvidia fell 2.03% during Monday trading, according to Reuters.
Investors were looking ahead to Nvidia earnings later in the week.
The decline contributed to pressure on the S&P 500 technology sector.

articles.title: Micron leads semiconductor losses in Monday selloff
bullets: Micron Technology shed 5.76% on Monday.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 2.64% to its lowest level in three weeks.
Chip weakness weighed on both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq.

articles.title: Altria and Philip Morris move after manufacturing pact
bullets: Altria and Philip Morris International announced contract manufacturing arrangements.
Altria said the arrangement is intended to improve operational efficiency.
Benzinga reported Altria and Philip Morris shares were both higher during Monday trading.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate deals, investments and company developments

articles.title: RUM Group signs $13.7 billion AI infrastructure contract
bullets: RUM Group announced a six-year contract with an unnamed U.S. cloud customer.
The agreement covers GPU services and related infrastructure.
The company said it still needs to raise capital to fulfill the contract.

articles.title: nVent to buy Maverick Power for $1.75 billion
bullets: nVent agreed to acquire Maverick Power for $1.75 billion, subject to adjustments.
The deal expands nVent’s exposure to data-center power distribution.
nVent expects the acquisition to be accretive to adjusted EPS in the first year after closing.

articles.title: Altria and Philip Morris International sign manufacturing agreements
bullets: The companies entered contract manufacturing arrangements with each other.
Altria said the deal supports operational efficiency and economic benefits.
The first shipments are expected in 2027, according to PMI.

articles.title: Saudi-funded €6 billion theme-park plan announced near Paris
bullets: France and Saudi Arabia agreed on a €6 billion amusement-park project.
The plan includes three parks near Paris, including a manga-themed site.
Officials said the project could create tens of thousands of jobs.

articles.title: Alibaba launches Wan3.0 AI video model after major share sale
bullets: Alibaba rolled out its Wan3.0 AI video-generation model on Monday.
The launch followed a roughly $10 billion share placement to fund AI spending.
The model has been used in short dramas, advertising, tourism and music-video production since beta release.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Technology, AI, cybersecurity and platform news

articles.title: Accel-backed Keenable builds web index for AI agents
bullets: Keenable came out of stealth with $26 million in seed funding.
The startup is building a web search index of more than 100 billion documents.
Its API is already used by AI labs and inference providers, according to TechCrunch.

articles.title: Alibaba makes Wan3.0 AI video model generally available
bullets: Alibaba officially launched Wan3.0 on Monday.
The model generates video from inputs such as text, images, video and audio.
The launch came as Alibaba raises funds for AI infrastructure and model development.

articles.title: Taiwan indicts nine over alleged illegal AI-server exports to China
bullets: Taiwanese prosecutors indicted nine people in an AI-server export-control case.
Those charged included employees of Nvidia and Super Micro, according to reports.
The case involves alleged illegal exports of high-end AI servers to China.

articles.title: Thomson Reuters launches proprietary frontier AI model
bullets: Thomson Reuters announced Thomson, its first proprietary large language model.
The company said the model was developed in-house using its professional data assets.
Thomson Reuters said it spent about $40 million on training, talent and compute.

articles.title: Waymo highlights custom chip for next-generation robotaxis
bullets: TechCrunch reported on Waymo’s custom chip for its robotaxi ambitions.
The chip is tied to Waymo’s next-generation Ojai robotaxi platform.
The effort is aimed at making future autonomous vehicles cheaper and more responsive.
